flows:
Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:8001/login then log in with email {{global.account1_email}} and password {{secrets.user.account1_password}}.
Open the appointment booking page.
Book an appointment for the first patient in the patient list on tomorrow's date at 10:00 and submit.
Open the appointment booking page again.
Book an appointment for the second patient in the patient list on tomorrow's date at 10:00 and submit.
Store what the page shows after that as 'what_happened'.
Verify that the second booking was refused with a message that the 10:00 slot tomorrow is already taken.
